Why do I say that Rand won't win the nomination? All of the other Republicans attack Paul on the national defense and foreign policy issues — and the polls show that Rand will lose because of it. Why do I say that Paul will wield political influence in the future? Polls say that libertarians — and right-libertarians and left-libertarians — are about 5%, or less, of voters.
